content.text: Siangpahrang lungthin teh tui ka lawng e patetlah ao teh,
BAWIPA kut dawk ao dawkvah, a ngainae koe lah a lawng sak.
Ma e hmunae dawk teh mae hringnuen heh a lan telah pouk awh,
hatei BAWIPA ni lungthin heh yawcu dawk a khing.
Lannae hoi kânging lah sak e heh
thuengnae hlak BAWIPA ni a ngaihnawn.
Kâoupnae minhmai hoi lunglennae lungthin hoi
tamikathoutnaw e hmaiim teh yon doeh.
Tami ka hratbat e pouknae ni tawntannae a tâcokhai,
hatei kâhruetcuet hoeh e pouknae ni voutnae a tâcokhai.
Laithoe dei laihoi hmu e hnopai teh
duenae ka tawng ni teh kahmat e patetlah ao.
Tamikathoutnaw e lawpnae ni amamouh a raphoe han,
bangkongtetpawiteh kânginglah lawkcengnae hah a pahnawt awh.
Tamikayon e lamthung teh a longkawi,
hatei tamikalan hanelah teh a tawk e hah kalan e doeh.
Ka hrawang e yu hoi im kalen dawk o hlak teh,
lemphu imtakin koe awm pawiteh bet ahawihnawn.
Tamikathout hringnae ni hnokathout a ngai,
a imrinaw ni ahnie pahrennae hmawt awh hoeh.
Kadudame taminaw reknae dawkvah
kamawngrame ni lungang a kâla awh,
hatei tamilungkaangnaw cangkhai navah panuenae a hmu awh.
Tamikalan ni tamikathout imthung hah kahawicalah a pouk,
hatei Cathut ni tamikathoutnaw teh
amamae thoenae lahoi a tâkhawng.
Tamimathoe hramnae lawk thai ngai laipalah
a hnâ ka tabuem e teh,
ama hai a hram toteh apinihai thai pouh mahoeh.
Arulahoi poe e poehno ni lungphuennae,
a lungtabue dawk poe e tadawnghno ni
puenghoi lungkhueknae a roum sak.
Kalan lah lawkcengnae e teh tamikalan hanelah konawmnae doeh,
hatei yonnae kasaknaw teh rawknae koe a pha awh han.
Thaipanueknae lam kaphennaw teh
tamikadoutnaw kamkhuengnae koe a kâhat van han.
Nawmnae dueng ka ngai e teh a mathoe han,
misurtui hoi satui ka ngai poung e teh tawnta mahoeh.
Tamikathout teh tamikalan hanelah,
Yuemkamcuhoeh e teh tamikalan ratangnae lah ao.
A lungkaduem ni teh ka hrawang e yu hoi o hlak teh,
ramkenae koe awm pawiteh bet ahawihnawn.
Tamilungkaang onae koe hno ngai kaawm hoi satui ao teh,
tamipathu ni teh a kaseikasak.
Lannae hoi lungmanae katawngnaw ni hringnae hoi
lannae hoi barinae ouk a hmu awh.
Tamilungkaang ni kacakpounge khopui dawk a kâen teh,
khocanaw ni a kângue e rapanim hah a tip sak.
A laihoi a pahni ka ring e teh runae thung hoi
a hringnae ouk a hlout.
Tami moikai hoi kâoup e teh a min patenghai
dudamkung telah a phung awh teh,
kâoup lungkhuek laihoi ouk a kâroe.
Tami ka pangak e teh thaw a tawk ngaihoeh dawkvah,
a doun e ni ama a thei.
Hnintangkuem nôe laihoi ao, hatei tamikalan niteh
pasai laipalah a poe.
Tamikathout e thuengnae teh panuet a tho,
hnokathout ngainae lungthin hoi thuengnae teh panuet hoe a tho.
Kapanuekkhaikung kaphawk teh takhoe lah ao han,
hatei kapanuekkhaikung katang ni a panue e patetlah
a dei e teh dâw lah ao han.
Tamikathout ni a minhmai tamundun lah a ta,
hatei tamikalan ni a lamthung a cak sak.
BAWIPA taranlahoi lungangnae, thaipanueknae,
hoi kâpankhainae awm hoeh.
Marangtan teh tarantuk hnin hanelah rakueng lah ao,
tânae teh BAWIPA e doeh.
